arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Jeffrey Fisher argued that precedent dictates the outcome here.
He stated that judges may only find what crime a defendant committed.
He emphasized that judges cannot find anything more than the elements.

The government advocate argued that the statute requires a recidivism determination. He claimed this legislative choice is consistent with the Constitution. He noted that judges must find the separateness of prior offenses.
